heading_en: Approval Before the Application Date for the SA-CVA
summary_ja: SA-CVAの使用承認を適用日前に申請・承認でき、適用日に承認されたものとみなす。
summary_en: Approval to use the SA-CVA may be applied for and granted before the Application Date and is deemed granted on that date.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company may, even before the Application Date, in accordance with Article 248-4-2 of the New Public Notice, apply for approval for the use of the SA-CVA.

Where an application has been made pursuant to the preceding paragraph, the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency may grant approval in accordance with Article 248-4, paragraph (1) of the New Public Notice. In this case, that approval is deemed to have been granted on the Application Date pursuant to that paragraph.
